values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, online or 1-800-456-2267. 'Walk-ins will not be permitted' at DEC campgrounds. DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

note: DEC (Adirondack), Brown's Tract Pond near Raquette Lake. 8 remote paddle/walk-in sites; no motors on the pond, rowboats and canoes for rent; gravel access. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $18 + $5 non-resident and 1-night reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary), phone, no electric, 90 sites to 30 ft, 2027 opening May 14. NEW: season close 09-05, 9-month window, same-day booking until 5 pm with no walk-ins, 14-night max; flush toilets, dump, water spigots; no pull-throughs. Showers not mentioned. Note: dropped count/hookup/length/booking restatements.
flags: Season note (manual, 2026-10-20) says 'Reservable through Sep 5, 2027 (Labor Day weekend); DEC posts no later date.' DEC's 2026 summary does post a close: 'Brown Tract Pond ... May 15 ... Sept 7' (Labor Day 2026). Suggest: 'Closes on Labor Day: Sep 7 in 2026 (DEC summary), Sep 5 in 2027 (ReserveAmerica).'
Minor: most bookable sites are listed at 20 ft (48 of 88); a 23-ft rig should pick from the 20 listed at 30 ft or the 20 with no length.
